item.title: Can We Compress Language Models Without Losing Their Skills? My JCDL '26 Paper
item.description: My JCDL '26 Doctoral Consortium paper proposes protecting the circuits behind a model's key capabilities while the rest is pruned and quantized for edge devices.

item.title: Terminatus: A Gatus Status Page in the Terminal
item.description: Every Gatus endpoint's state, response time, uptime and recent checks on one terminal screen.

item.title: boxglance: CPU, Memory, Disk and GPU Stats at a Glance
item.description: A single Bash script that shows a machine's CPU, memory, disk and NVIDIA GPU stats on one screen.

item.title: slurmtop: A Terminal Dashboard for Slurm Jobs
item.description: Your Slurm jobs, their priority, GPU partition load and your storage on one live terminal screen.

item.title: Black Screens After DPMS: How DisplayPort HPD Storms Drained 11 GB of VRAM
item.description: Displays on multi-GPU NVIDIA systems running GNOME on Wayland stayed black after DPMS. The cause was DisplayPort hotplug events from one monitor model, and the fix was in the monitor's settings.

item.title: Introducing kurdishscholars.org
item.description: A small project I've been building on the side. Sign up, poke around, and tell me what's broken.
